title: Festival access
bodyMd: A festival advertises free entry, but all performances take place upstairs in a building without a lift. An accessibility group says that removing a ticket price does not remove every obstacle to attendance. Organizers arrange a ground-floor performance and publish clear access information. They retain free admission but stop describing the original venue as accessible to everyone.
